def.short: a big test at school or university to show what you know
def.long: A big test at school or university that shows how much you know about a subject. Students usually take them at the end of the year.

examples.en: I have an exam on Monday.
She passed her driving exam on the first try.
The English exam was easier than I expected.

tr.note: 'Exam' önemli, resmî bir sınavdır. Kısa yazılı veya küçük sınavlar için 'test' veya 'quiz' denir. 'Sınava girmek' = take an exam.

mistakes.wrong: I will enter the exam tomorrow.
mistakes.right: I will take the exam tomorrow.
mistakes.why: Türkçede 'sınava girmek' deriz, ama İngilizcede 'enter' değil 'take (an exam)' kullanılır.

quiz.cloze: I must study tonight because my ______ is tomorrow.

def.short: to not get a good enough result in an exam or test
def.long: To not get a good enough result in an exam or test, so you do not pass it. Students who do this often have to take it again.

examples.en: He failed the driving test twice.
I studied hard because I didn't want to fail.
She failed her English exam, but she will try again.
examples.tr: İngilizce sınavından kaldı ama tekrar deneyecek.

tr.note: 'Fail' genel olarak 'başarısız olmak' da demektir; bu kart sınav anlamındadır. Karşıtı 'pass' (geçmek).

mistakes.why: Türkçede 'sınavdan kalmak' dediğimiz için 'from' eklenir; ama 'fail' doğrudan nesne alır: fail the exam.

quiz.cloze: He didn't study at all, so he is afraid he will ______ the exam.

def.short: to say or write the letters of a word in the right order
def.long: To say or write the letters of a word in the right order. People ask 'How do you spell it?' when they do not know the letters.

examples.en: How do you spell your name?
Can you spell that for me, please?
examples.tr: Bunu bana harf harf söyler misiniz?

examples.en: Many people spell 'necessary' wrong.

tr.note: Türkçedeki 'hecelemek' heceleri ayırır (ka-pı); 'spell' ise harfleri tek tek söyler (K-A-P-I). 'Nasıl yazılıyor?' = 'How do you spell it?'

quiz.cloze: Can you ______ your last name, please? I need to write it.

def.short: a piece of land with water all around it
def.long: A piece of land with water on all sides. It can be very small, with only a few trees, or large enough for a whole country.

examples.en: We spent a week on a small island.
examples.tr: Küçük bir adada bir hafta geçirdik.

examples.en: You can only get to the island by boat.
Büyükada is an island near Istanbul.

etymology.text: From Old English 'ieġland' ('water-land'). The 's' was added later, by mistake, from the unrelated word 'isle'. That is why it is silent.

tr.note: Okunuşu 'aylınd' gibidir; 's' harfi okunmaz. Adada olmak için 'on an island' denir.

mistakes.wrong: We stayed in a small island.
mistakes.right: We stayed on a small island.
mistakes.why: Türkçede '-da' eki 'in' gibi gelir, ama adalar için 'on' kullanılır: on an island.

tr.mnemonic: 'Island' içindeki 's' sonradan, 'isle' kelimesine benzesin diye eklendi. O yüzden okunmaz: 'aylınd'.

quiz.cloze: You can only reach the ______ by boat; there is no bridge.

def.micro: flat green part of a plant
def.short: a flat, usually green part of a tree or plant
def.long: A flat, usually green part that grows on a tree or plant. In autumn, the leaves of many trees turn yellow, red, or brown and fall to the ground.

examples.en: The leaves turn yellow in autumn.
A leaf fell into my coffee.
We raked the leaves in the garden.

tr.note: Çoğulu düzensizdir: leaf → leaves ('leafs' denmez). 'Leaf' kitap yaprağı için de kullanılabilir, ama bu kart bitki yaprağını anlatır.

mistakes.wrong: There are many leafs on the ground.
mistakes.right: There are many leaves on the ground.
mistakes.why: 'Leaf' kelimesinin çoğulu 'leaves'tir. -f ile biten bazı isimlerde f, v olur (leaf-leaves, knife-knives).

quiz.cloze: In autumn, the ______ fall from the trees.

def.short: a very small animal with six legs, like an ant, a bee, or a fly
def.long: A very small animal with six legs and often wings, such as a bee, an ant, or a fly. Some insects are helpful; others bite or eat plants.

examples.en: There are a lot of insects near the lake in summer.
examples.tr: Yazın gölün yakınında çok böcek oluyor.

examples.en: This spray keeps insects away.
Bees are important insects because they help flowers grow.
examples.tr: Arılar önemli böceklerdir, çünkü çiçeklerin büyümesine yardım eder.

tr.note: Türkçede 'böcek' her küçük canlıyı kapsayabilir. İngilizcede 'insect' altı bacaklı hayvandır; örümcek (spider) sekiz bacaklıdır, bu yüzden insect sayılmaz. Günlük dilde 'bug' da denir.
tr.mnemonic: Latince 'insectum' = 'çentikli, bölünmüş': karıncaya bak, gövdesi boğum boğum bölümlere ayrılmış.

quiz.cloze: A bee is a small ______ that makes honey.

def.short: a group of songs that you choose to hear one after another
def.long: A group of songs or videos that you choose and put together, so they come one after another. You can make one for the gym, for a party, or for a long trip.

examples.en: I made a new playlist for the gym.
examples.tr: Spor salonu için yeni bir çalma listesi hazırladım.

examples.en: Can you share your playlist with me?
This playlist is perfect for a long drive.
examples.tr: Bu çalma listesi uzun bir araba yolculuğu için mükemmel.

tr.note: Günlük dilde çoğu kişi 'playlist' der; müzik uygulamalarında 'Çalma listesi' yazar.

quiz.cloze: I made a new ______ with all my favorite songs for the trip.

def.short: a TV story shown in many parts, one after another
def.long: A TV or streaming show made of many parts that follow each other. The word is the same for one show and many shows: one series, two series.

examples.en: Have you seen the new series?
We watched a whole series in one weekend.
examples.tr: Bütün bir diziyi tek hafta sonunda izledik.

examples.en: My favorite series has five seasons.
examples.tr: En sevdiğim dizinin beş sezonu var.

tr.note: Tekil ve çoğul aynıdır: one series, two series ('serieses' denmez). Tek bir film için 'movie' veya 'film' kullanılır.

mistakes.wrong: I watched two serieses this month.
mistakes.right: I watched two series this month.

tr.mnemonic: Türkçedeki 'seri' ile aynı kelime: bölümler seri hâlinde, art arda gelir.

quiz.cloze: I stayed up all night to finish the whole ______ on my laptop.

def.micro: one part of a TV show
def.short: one part of a TV series, podcast, or other show
def.long: One part of a TV series, podcast, or radio show. Each one tells part of the story, and new ones often come out every week.

examples.en: I watched two episodes last night.
The last episode of the season was amazing.
A new episode comes out every Friday.
examples.tr: Her cuma yeni bir bölüm yayınlanıyor.

tr.note: Dizilerde 'bölüm' = episode, 'sezon' = season: 'Season 2, Episode 5' = 2. sezon 5. bölüm.

quiz.cloze: I can't wait for the next ______ of my favorite show!

def.short: a group of people who play music together
def.long: A group of musicians who play and often sing together, for example with guitars and drums. Many bands start in a garage or at school.

examples.en: My brother plays the drums in a band.
What is your favorite band?
The band played all their old songs at the concert.
examples.tr: Grup, konserde bütün eski şarkılarını çaldı.

tr.note: Günlük Türkçede kısaca 'grup' denir. 'Band' ayrıca lastik veya şerit (rubber band) anlamına da gelir; bu kart müzik grubunu anlatır.

quiz.cloze: She sings and plays the guitar in a ______ with her friends.
